F1 Interaction.text: ^start(hey) Hello everyone! I'm Haku, your friendly robot! ^pa 2.5 ^run(wave) ^start(hey) And this is my friend Bandit! ^pa 2.5 ^run(point) ^start(hey) We're here to have some fun with you today! ^pa 2.5 ^run(excited)

Bandit Introduction.text: ^speak Hello everyone, I'm Bandit. I'm here to support Haku and make sure everything runs smoothly. ^pa 3.5 ^run(Wave) ^speak Let's get started!

Haku Joke 1.text: ^start(hey) Why don't robots ever get lost? ^pa 2.5 ^start(thinking) Because they always follow their GPS! ^pa 2.5 ^run(laugh)

Bandit Joke 1.text: ^speak Good one, Haku. But I have a better one. Why did the robot go on a diet? ^pa 2.5 ^speak Because it had too many bytes! ^pa 2.5 ^run(laugh)

Haku Feud.text: ^start(hey) Oh yeah, Bandit? Well, at least I can dance! ^pa 2.5 ^run(dance)

Bandit Feud.text: ^speak True, Haku. But I can calculate complex equations in seconds. ^pa 2.5 ^run(point)

Haku Dance Lesson.text: ^start(hey) Alright everyone, let's teach one of the F1 drivers a dance! ^pa 2.5 ^run(dance) ^start(hey) Follow my lead! ^pa 2.5 ^run(dance)

Bandit Support.text: ^speak Great job, Haku! Keep it up! ^pa 2.5 ^run(clap)

Haku Dance Instructions.text: ^start(hey) Step one, move your arms like this! ^pa 2.5 ^run(dance) ^start(hey) Step two, spin around! ^pa 2.5 ^run(spin) ^start(hey) Step three, jump up and down! ^pa 2.5 ^run(jump)

Bandit Encouragement.text: ^speak You're doing great! Keep following Haku's instructions! ^pa 2.5 ^run(clap)

Haku Joke 2.text: ^start(hey) Why did the robot go to school? ^pa 2.5 ^start(thinking) Because it wanted to be a smart bot like Bandit! ^pa 2.5 ^run(laugh)

Bandit Joke 2.text: ^speak Nice one, Haku. But remember, I'm here to help you too. ^pa 2.5 ^run(point)

Haku Dance Wrap-Up.text: ^start(hey) Great job everyone! You've learned the dance! ^pa 2.5 ^run(clap) ^start(hey) Now let's show it off! ^pa 2.5 ^run(dance)

Bandit Closing.text: ^speak Thank you everyone for joining us! We had a great time! ^pa 2.5 ^run(Wave) ^speak Enjoy the rest of your day! ^pa 2.5 ^run(clap)
